changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.rollback: create or alter procedure [bulkload].[UpdateIntersectTypeColumn] @id int, @column int as begin set nocount on; update T set T.LookupObject = 'IntersectType', T.LookupObjectID = S.ID from LoadItemColumn T inner join IntersectTypeDetail S on coalesce(S.SubjectName,'') + ' ' + coalesce(S.PredicateName,'/') + ' ' + coalesce(S.ObjectName,'') = lower(T.Value) and T.ColumnIndex = @column and T.LoadID = @id and S.PredicateType not in (3,4) end
